question: Will the South Korean won close weaker than 1,340 per US dollar on October 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Spot ~1,331 on Oct 19 (TE 1,331.24; Yonhap Seoul close 1,330.3, fresh 2-year won high). Threshold 1,340 is ~+0.7% away with ~8 trading days left. Recent daily close-to-close moves ~0.4-0.5% imply ~1.4% 8-day sigma, so a driftless random walk gives ~32% for ending above 1,340. Shaded slightly lower for the month-long won-strengthening trend (exporter dollar selling, finance minister calling it a return to fundamentals, TE model ~1,325 for end-Q4). Partly offset by persistent foreign equity outflows and event risk from the BOK (Oct 22) and FOMC (Oct 28) decisions. No human prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
